description: Major lines, mounts, finger cues, hand shapes, basic compatibility — high-level traits only. No medical claims.
commercial_flags: Palmistry is symbolic/entertainment — never claim medical, lifespan, or clinical diagnosis from lines.
Life line does NOT predict length of life; phrase as vitality/energy patterns only.

major_lines.name: Heart line
major_lines.reads_for: Emotional style, relationship patterns, how affection is expressed

major_lines.name: Head line
major_lines.reads_for: Thinking style, communication, focus vs imagination

major_lines.name: Life line
major_lines.location: Arc around base of thumb / Venus mount
major_lines.reads_for: Vitality, energy, major life changes — NOT lifespan

major_lines.name: Fate line
major_lines.location: Vertical crease toward middle finger (often faint/absent)
major_lines.reads_for: Career direction, sense of destiny/structure; absence is common and meaningful as flexibility

mounts.name: Mars (upper/lower)
mounts.location: Between Head/Heart area and below Life line

finger_cues_beginner: Relative length: longer index (Jupiter) → leadership lean; longer ring (Apollo) → creative/recognition lean; longer little (Mercury) → communicative lean.
Shape keywords: spatulate (energy/action), square (practical), conic (artistic), pointed (idealistic) — beginner shorthand only.
Flexibility of thumb and fingers often read as adaptability vs fixed will — keep claims soft.

methods: Compare hand shapes: same element → easy rapport; adjacent elements (Fire-Air, Earth-Water) softer; opposite (Fire-Water, Earth-Air) need pacing and explicit empathy.
Compare Heart lines: similar curve/length → shared emotional tempo; very different → negotiate expression styles.
Optional cross with chart: Moon sign / Venus themes vs Heart line emotional style; Mercury vs Head line thinking style.
Dominant vs non-dominant hand: tradition often reads non-dominant as disposition/potential, dominant as developed pattern — compare both when available.
